name: EmbSpatial-Bench-tsv
description: EmbSpatial-Bench-tsv is a TSV-formatted benchmark intended to evaluate how well embedding models capture spatial relationships between entities. It is used for retrieval/ranking tasks where spatial similarity or relational geometry in embedding space is measured. Typically used to compare embedding models on their ability to preserve spatial semantics.
reputation: A small specialist benchmark on Hugging Face used by a limited group of researchers experimenting with spatial embedding evaluation.
